entities.summary: First Crusade, a transformative movement in Israel (1099–1291). Emerged from Latin Kingdom and First Crusade captures Jerusalem; massacre of Muslim and Jewish inhabitants. Catalyzed Saladin defeats the Crusaders at the Battle of Hattin and recaptures Jerusalem and Battle of Ain Jalut — Mamluks defeat the Mongols, saving the Islamic world.
